skills.summary: Tailor a resume to a job posting honestly
skills.job: Reorder and reword an existing resume to match a job posting using only experience the user really has, and list the gaps instead of covering them.
triggers: tailor my resume to this job
adapt my CV for this posting
match my resume to the job ad
gotchas: Adding skills the user does not have
Keyword stuffing that reads as empty
Dropping dates or titles to hide a gap

skills.summary: Prepare for a specific job interview
skills.job: Build a prep plan for one interview from the posting, the company and the user's background: likely questions, stories to ready and questions to ask.
triggers: I have an interview on Friday
gotchas: Rehearsing answers word for word
Skipping research on the interviewers
No questions prepared for the end

skills.summary: Shape work stories for behavioural questions
skills.job: Turn a rough work memory into a short story with situation, task, action and result that the user can adapt to several questions.
triggers: turn this experience into an interview story
gotchas: Using we when the user's own part is the point
Results with no numbers or outcome
One story forced onto every question

skills.summary: Review a professional profile for clarity
skills.job: Review a professional profile section by section against the user's goal and suggest specific rewrites that stay true to their record.
gotchas: Generic headlines that fit anyone
Claims the user cannot back in an interview
Rewriting the voice into buzzwords

skills.summary: Decode what a job posting really asks for
skills.job: Read a job posting, separate must-haves from wishes, spot red flags and open questions, and give the user a fit summary.
triggers: what are they really looking for
should I apply to this role
gotchas: Treating every bullet as a hard requirement
Reading vague pay or duties as a detail to skip
Judging fit without the user's own priorities

skills.summary: Plan research on pay for a role
skills.job: Plan how to find current pay ranges for a role and location from sources the user can check, and build the evidence for a pay discussion.
triggers: how much should I ask for
gotchas: Quoting numbers from memory as current
Mixing base pay with total package
Ignoring location and company size

skills.summary: Write a short note to a new contact
skills.job: Draft a brief, specific message to someone the user wants to learn from or be introduced by, with an easy way to say no.
triggers: write a message to a recruiter
reach out to someone on LinkedIn
gotchas: Asking a stranger for a job
Messages that are all about the sender
No clear small ask

skills.summary: Set up a tracker for a job search
skills.job: Build a simple tracker of applications, contacts and next steps with the dates needed to follow up on time.
triggers: set up a job search spreadsheet
keep track of where I applied
gotchas: Too many columns to maintain
No follow-up date column
Not saving the posting text before it disappears

skills.summary: Ask someone to be your reference
skills.job: Write a courteous request for a reference with the context the referee needs and an easy way to decline.
triggers: ask my manager for a reference
who should I ask for a reference
gotchas: Assuming the person will agree
Leaving out the role and deadline
Sending the posting without the points to cover

skills.job: Turn a hiring manager's notes into a plain job description with real duties, must-haves, nice-to-haves and an honest picture of the role.
triggers: draft a job ad for this role
gotchas: Long lists of must-haves nobody meets
Hiding pay or location details the user has
Using inflated language for ordinary duties

skills.summary: Build a structured interview question set
skills.job: Create a consistent set of interview questions tied to the role's needs with what a strong answer looks like, so all candidates are asked alike.
gotchas: Questions about protected or private topics
Different questions for each candidate
No scoring guide for answers

skills.summary: Score candidates against the same criteria
skills.job: Build a scorecard from role criteria and use it to compare candidates on notes the interviewer provides, keeping evidence next to each score.
gotchas: Scoring on likeability
Weights chosen after meeting the candidates
Using traits unrelated to the work

skills.job: Draft a performance review from the manager's notes and goals, with specific examples, balanced feedback and clear next-period goals.
triggers: help me with an employee review
draft feedback for my team member
gotchas: Vague praise or criticism with no example
Recent events outweighing the whole period
Comparing people instead of describing results

skills.summary: Map a one to three year career direction
skills.job: Help the user clarify what they want from work, map options and build a short plan with skills to grow, people to talk to and checkpoints.
triggers: what skills should I build next
gotchas: Plans built on job titles instead of daily work
Ignoring what the user dislikes
Goals with no checkpoint date
